correctness.rationale: Delicate cubefree means no factor XXX and every one-position bit flip creates some XXX. Cubefreeness is hereditary for factors; extending a cubefree prefix by one bit creates a cube only if it is a suffix, making breadth-first binary prefix generation exhaustive. Independently implemented a distinct full-factor cube scanner, built all cubefree words of lengths 1..22 and checked every bit flip at lengths 19..22. Level sizes n=20,21,22 equal 5324,7754,11320 and delicate counts are exactly 2,4,2, with no delicate words at 19 and exact six named orbit representatives; verified the listed eight words, three reversal/complement orbits sizes 2,4,2. The published spectrum says no admissible length below 20. This is complete enumeration of claimed finite scope, not evidence of an infinite classification.
